instruction: shipping.py repeats the same magic numbers in several functions. Refactor it so these values are defined once as module-level constants with exactly these names and values: FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD_CENTS = 5000, FLAT_RATE_CENTS = 499, EXPRESS_SURCHARGE_CENTS = 1500. The functions `shipping_cost`, `express_cost`, and `qualifies_for_free_shipping` must use the constants and must no longer contain the numeric literals 5000, 499, or 1500 in their bodies. Behavior and function signatures must not change. All tests in tests/test_shipping.py must pass.
